title: CIA Daily Bulletin (Historical)

origin.publisher: Central Intelligence Agency, Office of Current Intelligence (released via the CIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room)
origin.title: Current Intelligence Bulletin, 25 January 1957 (C03161983)
origin.clearance_note: A declassified CIA daily intelligence bulletin, released by the agency itself ('Approved for Release: 2019/12/04 C03161983' on every page) and published in its FOIA Electronic Reading Room; a work of the US federal government. cia.gov served a bot-check page to a scripted download, so the operator downloaded the PDF by hand on 2026-11-15; PDF metadata cleared. The blank boxes throughout are the CIA's own declassification redactions, gaps in the released scan. The bulletin is dated 25 January 1957, under the 72-year line, so clearance rests on the publisher's release rather than the historical exemption: every person named is a head of government, minister, diplomat or military officer acting in an official role (among them Nasser, Chou En-lai, Prime Minister Daud, Harold Macmillan, Duncan Sandys and Air Chief Marshal Sir William Dickson). No private individual appears.

notes: No feature page or fields were requested. The cover tells the document's whole life: a Top Secret bulletin of 25 January 1957, copy 131 of a numbered distribution, approved for public release on 2019-12-04. release.document_id (C03161983) grounds to the same release-stamp line as the date, so only the date is featured. The cover title and issuing office ground OFF: each is stacked across three or two lines and no single line holds the whole value. The contents list's 'redacted' flags are unreliable (see README).
